# Google Play release notes for the next build (at most 500 characters).
# Lines starting with # are ignored.

• Who approves (Developer switch): each person is now one card in clear sections, with much less text. Sending your Guardian card is an on/off switch, apart from stepping down.
• Stepping down as an approver now asks the other person to remove you. Until they do, you're still their approver. After a step-down, they can ask you again.
